replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Uhh... yeah... about that... it's not Yalahar... xD
Yalahar contains floating glowstone patterns, stained glass, smaller islands with different elevations, this map looks like Yalahar because it was built with birch planks, sandstone and one team is orange, and I suppose the placement of the three mini islands (that by convenient reference are much larger than Yalahar's) are placed similarly.
It looks somewhat like Yalahar, I agree, but it's not Yalahar, or Yalahar II, and it will play differently, that for sure.
